description: This file defines the TransactionFactory class, which models the <transaction-factory> XML element used in entity configuration. It includes methods to parse XML elements and retrieve configuration attributes related to transaction management.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: A class that models the <transaction-factory> element in entity configuration, providing access to its class name and nested JNDI configuration elements.

methods.name: TransactionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TransactionFactory object by parsing an XML element, extracting class name, and optional JNDI configuration elements.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class attribute value of the transaction factory.

methods.name: getUserTransactionJndi
methods.description: Returns the UserTransactionJndi object representing the <user-transaction-jndi> child element, or null if not present.

methods.name: getTransactionManagerJndi
methods.description: Returns the TransactionManagerJndi object representing the <transaction-manager-jndi> child element, or null if not present.
